verdict.rationale: Lever is a SaaS ATS with a public developer API (applications, webhooks, OAuth, audit events), so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test account, or non-production environment. Partner-page mentions of guides and example apps are adjacent material and do not establish isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
